card.name: Words about original design or intent
card.fires_on: Words that point to what something was designed or intended to do, such as devised, purposes, Framers, Founding, contemplated, in mind, or were made. Mostly in political or constitutional argument about original intent.

modes.label: Intent verbs
modes.description: A verb or noun of planning or purpose just before the word designed or intended would fit.
modes.example: natural immunization program<< devised>> by nature itself

modes.label: Founders and framers
modes.description: Start of words naming the people who drafted the Constitution, or the government bodies that did.
modes.example: The<< Found>>ing Fathers, rebelling against monarchy,

modes.label: Original purpose phrases
modes.description: Words in phrases saying what something was meant or made for.
modes.example: Trampolines were<< not>> designed to be backyard toys.

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with designed, intended, designer and the Chinese word for design.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about what someone originally meant or designed something to do, especially the Founders and the Constitution.
